title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a compound reference locates an authority passage inside an entry rather than asserting a medical relation
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. A medical register can route a complaint query to an entry and an authority-associated subdivision while omitting formulation and environmental qualifications. Explore a shared compound locator whose outer entry context scopes a repeated inner reference, without interpreting it as a dose, plant name or medical predicate.

design.source_status: Root-reported native source observation, not independently inspected by this producer. Receipt details remain to be attached by root; the source-selection decision is RECIPROCAL_SOURCE_DECISION.md in this dossier.
design.reported_source_observation: Root reports BSB bsb00057068 Gart1485 register canvas685 with head-pain-from-heat heading and references13/Diasco9 and36/Diasco18-19. Root reports the linked clauses omit different conditions from the register. Exact signs, whether numbers denote numbered subparagraphs, and complete destination boundaries are not independently established here.
design.production_model: A compiler builds a finding aid from prose: the heading supplies a search topic, and the body gives a compound bibliographic destination. The reference asserts relevance or navigability, not the entire medical recommendation. Its nested destination fields may be repeated at several positions without naming several objects.
design.finite_content_construction: For query H, consult entry E, authority-associated subsection A, local selector J. The actual source text reached may carry formulation F or condition C not reproduced under H. These are typed anonymous variables, not proposed Voynich values.
competing_accounts: SCOPED_LOCATOR: E scopes A/J; equal inner selector can reach different passages when E differs. Two selectors under the same E/A retrieve two loci rather than prescribing two doses.
FLAT_MEDICAL_PREDICATE: the repeated inner form itself asserts a stable drug-property or quantity, regardless of entry context.
FLAT_GLOBAL_LOCATOR: the inner identifier always retrieves the same passage independently of E.
design.unequal_consequence: A scoped locator must preserve a single rule for destination resolution and repeated inner selectors while allowing different linked medical clauses. The flat predicate cannot license omission of its claimed medical content merely because a reference occurred; the flat locator cannot let E change the destination. Neither a successful pointer nor a shared heading entails equal formulations or equal contraindications.
design.positive_structure_used: Hierarchical spaces and directed core/wrapper composition permit but do not prove nested coordinates; entry-context effects motivate a separately declared context dependency. Whole-form residuals prohibit a free affix stripping rule. GDT259 establishes heterogeneous internal reuse positions, so this proposal requires no fixed paragraph ordinal or line-end address.
design.native_anchor_status: No candidate Voynich form selected or translated. Report-owned GDT259 spans okaly at f80r.31 and okal at f82r.6 illustrate heterogeneous positions only, not a validated compound locator. GDT793 prevents promoting these motivating forms as recovered owners or ordered values.
design.smallest_next_step: On the already acquired historical source, explicitly resolve each of the first two register references into its complete destination and record which written field selects entry, authority and subunit. Compare scoped and flat reference interpretations there. Then, if root nominates a previously owned written compound family, draft one analogous native reference account with exact profiles before any value assignment; do not launch a decoder or count matching chapter sizes.
